segments.title: Hulk Hogan · promo / interview
segments.result: Made his case for the WrestleMania VIII title shot; named Flair's challenger at a press conference (Sid Justice walked off); closing comments about the SNME tag with Sid vs. Flair & Undertaker
segments.context: Also in the segment: Jack Tunney, Sid Justice, Ric Flair, The Undertaker. Recorded 1992-01-07. Combined coverage of broadcasts on 1992-01-25, 1992-02-08. Venue: Ocean Center, Daytona Beach, FL.
